newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index firms slightly on gains to VSZ.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index firms slightly on gains to VSZ.

text.p: Slovak shares were mostly steady in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Wednesday, with the 16-share SAX index firming slightly on gains to steel maker VSZ.
VSZ increased by 20 crown to 745, on a volume of 3,239 shares, while Slovnaft traded 9,030 shares, mostly in blocks, closing down five crowns at 1,000 crowns.

"I think the current sluggish trend will affect trading at least until the end of the week," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said. "I think both these issues attract investor interest relatively enough at their current prices," Briska said.
"I don't expect any of these two to jump or fall significantly in these days," he added.
Overall volume increased to 527,757 shares, from 250,954 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover rose to 340.74 million crowns, from 289.2 million.
